summary: Connect climate hazard screening to infrastructure appraisal, procurement and oversight. Review the course outline and practical outputs.
lede: Climate-risk screening for infrastructure planning assesses how hazards could affect assets and the services they support. It is intended for infrastructure planners, public investment managers and engineering project managers who need to connect screening evidence with appraisal, procurement and implementation oversight, rather than produce detailed engineering designs. Participants practise distinguishing hazards, exposure and vulnerability, comparing resilience options using lifecycle costs and multi-criteria appraisal, and translating decisions into procurement requirements and monitoring indicators.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make, assess or oversee infrastructure investment and delivery decisions. It suits managers who need to connect climate hazard screening with appraisal, procurement and implementation controls rather than produce detailed engineering designs.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of infrastructure project planning, appraisal, procurement or implementation oversight is recommended. No coding or specialist engineering design work is required. You should be ready to assess project evidence and discuss investment decisions.
